title: Happy cow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='25' y='42' width='52' height='32' rx='16' fill='#f7f7f0'/>
  <!-- body patches -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='55' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='60' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='70' width='8' height='15' rx='3' fill='#f7f7f0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='70' width='8' height='15' rx='3' fill='#f7f7f0'/>
  <rect x='56' y='70' width='8' height='15' rx='3' fill='#f7f7f0'/>
  <rect x='68' y='70' width='8' height='15' rx='3' fill='#f7f7f0'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='32' y='81' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6a5a4a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='81' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6a5a4a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='81' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6a5a4a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='81' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6a5a4a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='28' y='18' width='44' height='30' rx='14' fill='#f7f7f0'/>
  <!-- head patch -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='26' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='22' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f7f7f0' transform='rotate(-20 27 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='22' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f7f7f0' transform='rotate(20 73 22)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <rect x='33' y='10' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8d8a0' transform='rotate(-15 35 15)'/>
  <rect x='62' y='10' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8d8a0' transform='rotate(15 65 15)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='32' r='4' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='4' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='31' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='31' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='13' ry='8' fill='#f2b8b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='42' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#a06868'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='42' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#a06868'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 52 56 47' stroke='#a06868' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#f7a8c0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#f7a8c0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M77 58 Q86 54 84 64' stroke='#f7f7f0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='66' r='3' fill='#6a5a4a'/>
</svg>
